Want to experience the nano-texture feel of the iPad screen but not ready to commit? Astropad has launched a brand-new version of Rock Paper Pencil, retaining the detachable design while adding a second writing feel.

Apple Pencil paired with iPad now offers the feel of a pencil — the all-new Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 officially arrives

Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 combines a screen protector with nano-texture and a specially designed Apple Pencil tip. For the first time, buyers can choose between two options: the smooth feel of a ballpoint pen, or the soft, higher-friction drag of graphite.

The all-new graphite tip mimics the feel of a 2B pencil, adding extra friction to meet the needs of artists sketching, shading, and expressing brushstrokes.

Astropad stated that developing this new option took approximately one year, using a standard 2B pencil as the reference benchmark. The company also stated that the finished product recreates the visual and sound effects of real graphite.

Ballpoint pen or standard pencil feel — your choice

The original steel ballpoint tip is retained, suitable for writing, line outlining, fine-line drawing, and neat note-taking. Each Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 set now comes with four Apple Pencil tips: two ballpoint tips and two graphite tips.

The screen protector itself remains unchanged. Astropad's patented NanoCling system uses electrostatic adhesion rather than adhesive, so it can be applied, removed, and reused at any time without leaving any residue.

The company stated that this adhesion is stronger than magnets, while supporting bubble-free application and easy removal. The protector's micro-texture mimics the feel of fine-grain paper, providing friction and better control.

The best matte screen protector for iPad

Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 is more than just swapping an Apple Pencil nib or changing the screen texture — it treats the two as an integrated system. Astropad stated that the specialised tip is designed specifically for the nano-texture protector. The all-new graphite tip is made of POM, while the ballpoint tip is made of steel.

Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 is now on sale, priced at USD 49.99, with free shipping worldwide. Version 3.0 is also on sale simultaneously, while stocks last, and comes with a discount offer.
